22 class StatePublisher(object):
23  """
24  This object read Transformation Publisher and Publish the RobotState
25  in the Topic '/niryo_robot/robot_state' at a certain rate
26  """
27 
28  def __init__(self, arm_state):
29  self.__arm_state = arm_state
30 
31  self.__last_robot_state = RobotState()
32  self.__last_stamp = rospy.Time.now()
33 
34  self.__transform_handler = self.__arm_state.transform_handler
35 
36  # State publisher
37  self.__robot_state_publisher = rospy.Publisher("/niryo_robot/robot_state", RobotState, queue_size=5)
38 
39  # Get params from rosparams
40  rate_publish_state = rospy.get_param("/niryo_robot/robot_state/rate_publish_state")
41  rospy.logdebug("StatePublisher.init - rate_publish_state: %s", rate_publish_state)
42 
43  rospy.Timer(rospy.Duration(1.0 / rate_publish_state), self.__publish_states)
44 
45  def __get_robot_state(self):
46  try:
47  t = self.__transform_handler.lookup_transform("base_link", "TCP", rospy.Time(0))
48  except (LookupException, ConnectivityException, ExtrapolationException) as e:
49  if isinstance(e, ExtrapolationException):
50  print(e)
51  self.__transform_handler.set_empty_tcp_to_ee_link_transform("tool_link")
52  rospy.loginfo_throttle(1, "State Publisher - Failed to get TF base_link -> TCP")
53  return
54 
55  robot_state = RobotState()
56  robot_state.position = t.transform.translation
57  robot_state.orientation = t.transform.rotation
58  quaternion_list = quaternion_to_list(t.transform.rotation)
59  robot_state.rpy = list_to_rpy(euler_from_quaternion(quaternion_list))
60 
61  dt = (t.header.stamp - self.__last_stamp).to_sec()
62  if dt == 0:
63  return self.__last_robot_state
64 
65  position_array = numpy.array(vector3_to_list(t.transform.translation))
66  last_position_array = numpy.array(vector3_to_list(self.__last_robot_state.position))
67  linear_velocity = [round(x, 4) for x in (position_array - last_position_array) / dt]
68 
69  orientation_array = numpy.array(quaternion_list)
70  last_orientation_array = numpy.array(quaternion_to_list(self.__last_robot_state.orientation))
71  angular_velocity = [round(x, 4) for x in (orientation_array - last_orientation_array) / dt]
72 
73  robot_state.twist.linear = list_to_vector3(linear_velocity)
74  robot_state.twist.angular = list_to_vector3(angular_velocity)
75  robot_state.tcp_speed = np.linalg.norm(linear_velocity)
76 
77  self.__last_stamp = t.header.stamp
78  self.__last_robot_state = deepcopy(robot_state)
79  return robot_state
80 
81  def __publish_states(self, _):
82  robot_state = self.__get_robot_state()
83  if robot_state is None:
84  return
85  robot_state.orientation = get_orientation_from_angles(robot_state.rpy.roll,
86  robot_state.rpy.pitch,
87  robot_state.rpy.yaw)
88 
89  try:
90  self.__robot_state_publisher.publish(robot_state)
91  except Exception:
92  return
